item.title: Stockyards cattle drive adds extra holiday shows this season
item.description: The twice-daily Fort Worth Herd cattle drive in the Stockyards will add evening runs during the holidays, organizers said.

item.title: Dallas ISD trustees debate new school start times
item.description: The Dallas school board heard three hours of comment on moving high school start times later.

item.title: Texas Legislature weighs statewide property tax changes
item.description: Lawmakers in Austin opened hearings on a package of property tax bills.

item.title: Arlington police arrest suspect after chase ends near AT&T Stadium
item.description: Arlington police arrested a driver after a short pursuit that ended in a parking lot near AT&T Stadium. No injuries were reported.
